meta.title: Fast shell
meta.description: Runs every Windows command through cmd.exe instead of PowerShell: about 0.15 s startup instead of about 1.5 s on this machine, the same user permissions, and GBK/UTF-8 output decoded correctly. Adds the fastsh tool and disables the pwsh tool, so all models must use it; pass shell: "powershell" for PowerShell cmdlets or .NET. Background runs become DSH jobs, return a job id, and end the turn.
